📺 House M.D. (2004–2012)

House M.D. follows Dr. Gregory House, a brilliant but unconventional medical genius who leads a team of diagnosticians at Princeton-Plainsboro Teaching Hospital. Known for his sarcastic personality, unusual methods, and extraordinary ability to solve mysterious illnesses, House takes on complicated medical cases that leave other doctors completely baffled. Despite his exceptional intelligence, he struggles with chronic pain, addiction, and difficult relationships with colleagues and patients. Alongside his team, House challenges medical assumptions, breaks hospital rules, and searches for answers when lives are on the line. Combining fascinating medical mysteries, sharp humor, emotional storytelling, and unexpected twists, the series explores human behavior, morality, friendship, and the complicated relationship between genius and personal struggles.

🎭 Genre: Medical Drama • Mystery • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 8.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: ~44 minutes per episode • 8 seasons • 177 episodes

🎥 Creator: David Shore

🏆 Recognition: Starring Hugh Laurie, Robert Sean Leonard, and Lisa Edelstein, the series won multiple Primetime Emmy Awards and Golden Globe Awards. Hugh Laurie’s iconic performance as Dr. House earned widespread critical acclaim and made the character one of television’s most memorable doctors.

📺 Where to Watch: Check Hulu, Peacock, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV for current streaming or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.
